_about: Semgrep baseline for career-ai per the global ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md rule.
Re-scan after PR merge, >=20 changed files, dep-manifest bumps,

rationale: career-ai is a local single-user CLI. The rule was authored
for the actix-web request-handler model where paths flow from
HTTP requests (untrusted). Here the path sources are: CLI args
and config-file values (operator-edited). There is no
untrusted-network input boundary that this guards.
If we ever add a multi-user surface or accept paths from a
remote API, re-evaluate every site individually.
writes the binary's resolved path into the systemd unit's
ExecStart so a renamed/moved binary is detected via
is meaningful for a single-user install command.
`std::env::temp_dir()` is used by the LLM probe to write a
tiny ping-prompt and read it back via the `claude --print`
subprocess. No secrets are written; no race-window matters

next_action: All findings are acknowledged. No critical/high requiring
remediation. Re-baseline per the global rule's triggers.
